resources.string: Keeps the UmbraC2 beacon session alive
Keeps the UmbraC2 beacon session alive and lets it read the screen of the phone and act on it. The service is visible in the Android settings and Android shows a notification while it runs.

UmbraC2 test implant.\n\nThis application connects to a team server you configured at build time and reports basic device information and command output. Install it only on devices you own or are explicitly authorised to test.
